name: mediasoup-worker

on:
  push:
    branches: [v3]
    paths:
      - 'worker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/mediasoup-worker.yaml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'worker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/mediasoup-worker.yaml'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  # Cancel a currently running workflow from the same PR, branch or tag when a
  # new workflow is triggered.
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # The `release` and `release:rust` npm scripts push a version-bump commit whose
  # message carries a `[no-ci]` marker, which skips the `ci` job below. A run
  # whose jobs are all skipped concludes as "skipped", which GitHub renders as a
  # red "failing" status badge. This tiny job runs ONLY on those commits so the
  # run concludes as "success" -> the branch badge stays green. On any other
  # event it is skipped and `ci` alone drives the result.
  no-ci-badge-guard:
    if: ${{ contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[no-ci]') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    steps:
      - run: 'true'

  ci:
    # Skip the release commit pushed by `npm run release` (its message carries a
    # `[no-ci]` marker): it only bumps version/CHANGELOG and the release is
    # driven by the tag-triggered workflows. On `pull_request` there is no
    # `head_commit`, so the guard is a no-op and the job runs.
    if: ${{ !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[no-ci]') }}
    strategy:
      # Here we want to see all errors, not just the first one.
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        build:
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            cc: gcc
            cxx: g++
            build-type: Release
            run-lint: false
            run-test: true
            run-test-asan-address: false
            run-test-asan-undefined: false
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            cc: clang
            cxx: clang++
            build-type: Release
            run-lint: false
            run-test: true
            run-test-asan-address: false
            run-test-asan-undefined: false
          - os: ubuntu-22.04-arm
            cc: gcc
            cxx: g++
            build-type: Release
            # No clang-format for ARM.
            run-lint: false
            run-test: true
            run-test-asan-address: false
            run-test-asan-undefined: false
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            cc: gcc
            cxx: g++
            build-type: Release
            pip-break-system-packages: true
            run-lint: false
            run-test: true
            run-test-asan-address: false
            run-test-asan-undefined: false
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            cc: gcc
            cxx: g++
            build-type: Debug
            pip-break-system-packages: true
            run-lint: false
            run-test: true
            run-test-asan-address: false
            run-test-asan-undefined: false
          - os: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            cc: gcc
            cxx: g++
            build-type: Release
            pip-break-system-packages: true
            # No clang-format for ARM.
            run-lint: false
            run-test: true
            run-test-asan-address: false
            run-test-asan-undefined: false
          - os: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            cc: clang
            cxx: clang++
            build-type: Release
            pip-break-system-packages: true
            # No clang-format for ARM.
            run-lint: false

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
